About

This site is an independent directory of AI tools for contractors and trade businesses. It exists because most "best AI tools" lists are written by people who have never run a job, and they group tools by category rather than by the job you are actually trying to get done.

Who writes this

This directory is edited by Yi Liu (Editor). Every tool description is checked by hand against the vendor’s own pricing and feature pages rather than pulled from a feed, and prices are re-checked on a schedule. Where a tool has little or no real AI, we say so plainly — including for tools we otherwise recommend.

How we choose tools

A tool is listed only if it does at least one job a trade business genuinely pays for: quoting, scheduling, invoicing, customer communication, site documentation, marketing or bookkeeping. We favour tools that are actually used in the trades over generic small business software with an AI badge.

What we say plainly

  • When a tool's value is traditional software rather than AI, we say so.
  • When a tool has a real free tier, we mark it.
  • We do not rank tools by affiliate commission.

What we are not

We are not a software vendor and we do not provide professional, legal or financial advice. Confirm pricing, features and suitability with the vendor before you commit to anything.
